Specification: Model-checking harness for the Paxos specification. Defines small finite constants for acceptors, values, quorums, and ballots; defines symmetry sets; provides a liveness specification with weak fairness for Phase1a/Phase2a/Phase1b/Phase2b actions; and provides an inductive-invariant rewriting (IInv/MCISpec) plus per-conjunct invariants Inv1..Inv4 and the refinement property MCIProp.
DivisionNotes: ITypeOK, IInv, Inv1..Inv4 are placed in OperatorDefNames_StatePredicate as they assert constraints over the (current) state of variables (e.g., maxBal, msgs, etc.).

MCLSpec, MCISpec, MCIProp, MCLiveness, and VotingSpecBar are placed in OperatorDefNames_TemporalProperty because they include temporal operators such as [], <>, WF_, or instantiate temporal Spec definitions of other modules.
There are no Init-style predicates introduced in this module (the verifier reuses Init/TypeOK from Paxos via EXTENDS); OperatorDefNames_Init is empty.
MCAcceptor, MCValue, MCQuorum, MCMaxBallot, MCBallot, MCSymmetry are placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef as they define plain constant/value structures (sets, scalars, symmetry permutation sets).
FunctionConstructor entries are all of the form [Domain -> Range], so they are partitioned into FunctionConstructor_SetType.
There are no UNCHANGED expressions in this module.
TemporalNesting is false: the temporal formulas in MCPaxos use only top-level [] and <> with non-temporal bodies (no [] inside <> or vice versa).
VerificationTools includes TLC because the module EXTENDS the TLC tooling module and is explicitly a model-checking harness.
